subject: Sweave output with ggplot2: suppressing mgcv warnings

messages.author: 46f0fec04a5c6039
messages.subject: Sweave output with ggplot2: suppressing mgcv warnings
parts:
I am embedding ggplot2 output in a sweave document, and I get the
following output when I use stat_smooth() with a large number of
points:

This is mgcv 1.5-0 . For overview type `help("mgcv-package")'.


The Latex/Sweave command that causes this is:

\begin{figure}
\begin{center}
<<fig=TRUE>>=
print(ggplot(web, aes(x=score, y=grade)) + stat_smooth())
@
\caption{Calibration curve using a smooth local interpolator}
\label{fig:calibration_smooth}
\end{center}
\end{figure}

Is there an easy way to suppress the text output in the latex
document?
Thanks

Just do library(mgcv) earlier where the output isn't included.

messages.author: 91408d9f82fba469
messages.subject: Re: Sweave output with ggplot2: suppressing mgcv warnings
parts:
The easiest I have found is to include the loading of the packages
inside a chunk with results=hide, as in

<<packages,results=hide>>=
require(mgcv)
@

Kasper
